phases.name: The White Ox
phases.say: You have seen the king. Now see the ox.

say.open: Pilgrims on the western road pay the toll at my mountain. You will pay it too, one way or another.

bestiary.lore: The demon king of the western road, who kept a mountain on fire to tax the pilgrims who passed it, and fought a monkey for forty days. The Shrine's pilgrims pay the same toll.
bestiary.weakness: Water, heavily. Interrupt the Flaming Mountain while it builds; when he roars, wait out the Protect or dispel it.
bestiary.pattern: The Flaming Mountain burns everyone every fourth turn, the white ox's horns gore a row every third, and the iron cudgel finds the strongest between. At half he roars (Might and Protect) every fourth turn and gores every other.
